name: Fluxmaster

bonuses.name: Disc of Tzeentch
bonuses.text: In melee, the Fluxmaster can make one Ritual Knife attack and one Blades attack each turn.

bonuses.name: Ritual Dagger
bonuses.text: Any time the Ritual Knife wounds an opponent, the Fluxmaster gains the same number of wounds.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 4 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Magic Made Manifest
abilities.text: Spend 1 ruin to activate the Smite Psychic Power. This power is always activated at the Transcendent Power Level.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Speed printed '12(Flying)'. Keyword PSKYER printed as such (likely PSYKER). No salvo printed for Coruscating Flames.
